title: Popup position is wrong for rotated applets on a desktop and popup flashes if the mouse cursor hovers over it
line: Tooltips and popups of rotated desktop widgets now open next to the widget instead of on top of it.
explanation: PopupPlasmaWindow (used by applet popups and tooltips) built its anchor rect from the visual parent's mapped top-left corner plus its unrotated size. For a rotated desktop widget that rect is the unrotated box hanging off the rotated top-left corner, so a popup below or above it lands on top of the widget, and a tooltip under the pointer hides and reappears in a loop. The change maps the whole item rect to the scene, giving the rotated bounding box; for unrotated items the rect is unchanged.

commits.message:
plasmaquick: anchor popups to the visual parent's rotated bounds

The anchor rect was built from the visual parent's mapped top-left
corner and its unrotated size, so popups and tooltips of rotated desktop
widgets ended up on top of the widget. Map the whole rect instead.

BUG: 501691

media.caption: Master: hovering a Digital Clock rotated 45° shows its tooltip on top of the clock
Fixed: the tooltip opens below the rotated clock
Master: clicking it opens the calendar over the clock
Fixed: the calendar opens below the rotated clock

review.text: Textbook one-line root-cause fix in libplasma. Replacing the top-left-plus-unrotated-size rect with QQuickItem::mapRectToScene() gives the rotated bounding box for rotated desktop widgets while remaining identical for unrotated items. Screenshots and autotests cleanly confirm that both tooltips and applet popups now open outside the rotated widget rather than on top of it.

reviews.text: Textbook one-line root-cause fix in libplasma. Replacing the top-left-plus-unrotated-size rect with QQuickItem::mapRectToScene() gives the rotated bounding box for rotated desktop widgets while remaining identical for unrotated items. Screenshots and autotests cleanly confirm that both tooltips and applet popups now open outside the rotated widget rather than on top of it.

The libplasma change is the right root cause for applet tooltips and popups: PopupPlasmaWindow combined the mapped top-left corner with the unrotated size, and mapRectToScene gives the rotated item's bounding box while leaving unrotated items (panels, every normal applet) unchanged. The screenshots show the clock tooltip and calendar moving from on top of the rotated clock to below it, which also removes the cause of the hover flicker. But the reporter's description (and TraceyC's confirmation in c1) explicitly includes the edit-mode toolbar tooltips (rotate, configure, show/hide background, remove) being offset on a rotated widget, and the notes admit those still are, because they are PC3.ToolTips in plasma-desktop's ActionButton/ConfigOverlay, so this fix only covers part of the bug.
changes: Also fix the edit-mode toolbar tooltips on rotated desktop widgets in plasma-desktop (containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ActionButton.qml / ConfigOverlay.qml, e.g. position the PC3.ToolTip from the button's rotation-aware mapped rect or parent it outside the rotated item), with before/after screenshots of a rotated widget's toolbar tooltips, and give that commit BUG: 501691 alongside the libplasma one

Alternatively, if the toolbar part is split into its own report, change this commit to CCBUG: 501691 and reference the new bug, since BUG: here would close the report with the toolbar part still broken
